head: e40368a5
headSubject: fix(kernel): REG-221 -- extend java/io/ exemption to InputStream/OutputStream supertypes
summary: Completed the carried-over NEXT (regenerate live wmsoffice-browser to pick up REG-219/REG-220): built a clean wmsoffice-browser-v2 root from a scenario-renamed scratch copy of WmsOffice (never touching the real live app's seeded repro data, since its data/logs/secrets sit at its root rather than under the standard App/ subfolder the platform's spare-on-wipe logic expects). That build revealed REG-219's exemption was too narrow -- fixed as REG-221 (extended UntrustedExtensionBytecodeInspector's java/io/ exemption to the abstract InputStream/OutputStream supertypes, not just the concrete ByteArrayInputStream/ByteArrayOutputStream classes; DocumentBuilder.parse(InputStream) encodes the abstract param type in its descriptor, not the concrete class constructed). Fixed with two new regression tests, all green, committed and pushed (e40368a5). Live-reverified: the java/io/ violation is gone from the boot log entirely.
nextStep: Close out REG-222 (OPEN): rewrite AllocationCapability.java and FiscalImportCapability.java (AppGen/apps/_official/WmsOffice/definition/capabilities/) to remove all lambdas/method references (Comparator.comparing/thenComparing, .stream().anyMatch/allMatch, Long::sum) -- B30 bans java/lang/invoke/LambdaMetafactory outright for plugin capability code, by design, and both files violate it throughout. This is the ONLY remaining boot blocker for WmsOffice (confirmed live: after REG-221's fix, the boot log shows zero java/io/ violations, only the two LambdaMetafactory ones). Once rewritten, rebuild wmsoffice-browser-v2, confirm it boots clean, then re-verify REG-218 (Importar Contagem JAVA_SOURCE_OPERATION_NOT_BOUND survives a fresh build) and CrossDocking C4/C5 (Importar (Parse Romaneio) action button) -- the original ask this session was carrying over. Also worth a quick look while there: PluginJavaSourcePolicyVisitor (generation-time AST gate) has no lambda-syntax check at all, so this class of violation only surfaces at boot, not generation -- noted as an open design question in REG-222, not decided.
plan: ledger/items/REG-221.yml (DONE, this session), ledger/items/REG-222.yml (OPEN, this session) -- both supersede this session's carried-over NEXT from REG-219/REG-220's closeout; WMS-9.yml sweep and the mega roadmap outside the repo remain the longer-range context
blocked: WmsOffice live app cannot boot at all right now (B30 LambdaMetafactory ban on both plugin capability classes) -- the original live wmsoffice-browser (port 8084) was deliberately stopped this session and left stopped (its pre-REG-219/220/221 build+data are untouched, could be restarted as-is if a live app is needed before REG-222 closes, but that would mean running with none of this session's three fixes); wmsoffice-browser-v2 is a clean build with all three fixes and a fresh JWT keypair but an EMPTY database (no repro data) and cannot boot until REG-222's app-side rewrite lands
verified: Narrow unit tests: gradlew -p NPDevKernel/kernel test --tests com.npdev.kernel.security.UntrustedExtensionBytecodeInspectorTest (BUILD SUCCESSFUL, incl. 2 new REG-221 regression tests, all pre-existing tests including the REG-219 pair still green). Live verification: rebuilt+rebooted wmsoffice-browser-v2 twice (before/after the REG-221 fix) -- boot log before showed 'forbidden owner java/io/' on FiscalImportCapability.class, boot log after shows that violation gone entirely, only the unrelated LambdaMetafactory violations (REG-222) remain. No full quality gate run this session -- narrow verification only, per project norms for a targeted fix.
